title: Noclip  by Skibidi_Fontan121
script:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInput=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local lp=Players.LocalPlayer
local pg=lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old=pg:FindFirstChild("Noclip") if old then old:Destroy() end

local sg=Instance.new("ScreenGui",pg)
sg.Name="Noclip" sg.ResetOnSpawn=false sg.IgnoreGuiInset=true

local m=Instance.new("Frame",sg)
m.Size=UDim2.new(0,220,0,116)
m.Position=UDim2.new(0,60,0,100)
m.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(14,14,18)
m.BorderSizePixel=0 m.Active=true m.Draggable=true
Instance.new("UICorner",m).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
local ms=Instance.new("UIStroke",m) ms.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,60) ms.Thickness=1.5

local t=Instance.new("TextLabel",m)
t.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,22) t.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,8)
t.BackgroundTransparency=1 t.Text="NOCLIP  •  "..lp.Name
t.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(240,240,245) t.TextSize=13 t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold

local b=Instance.new("TextButton",m)
b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,36) b.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,36)
b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,60)
b.Text="ВЫКЛ" b.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
b.TextSize=14 b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold b.AutoButtonColor=false
Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)

local hk=Instance.new("TextLabel",m)
hk.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,14) hk.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-36)
hk.BackgroundTransparency=1 hk.Text="клавиша: N"
hk.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(140,140,155) hk.TextSize=10 hk.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham

local by=Instance.new("TextLabel",m)
by.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,14) by.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-20)
by.BackgroundTransparency=1 by.Text="by Skibidi_Fontan121"
by.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,60) by.TextSize=10 by.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold

local on=false

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not on then return end
    local ch=lp.Character
    if not ch then return end
    for _,p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.CanCollide=false
        end
    end
end)

local function hook(ch)
    ch.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
        if on and d:IsA("BasePart") then
            task.wait()
            d.CanCollide=false
        end
    end)
end

if lp.Character then hook(lp.Character) end
lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
    task.wait(0.3)
    hook(ch)
end)

local function toggle()
    on=not on
    if on then
        b.Text="ВКЛ"
        b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,220,120)
        ms.Color=Color3.fromRGB(80,220,120)
    else
        b.Text="ВЫКЛ"
        b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,60)
        ms.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,60)
        local ch=lp.Character
        if ch then
            for _,p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide=true end
            end
        end
    end
end

b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggle)

UserInput.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.N then toggle() end
end)

print("[NOCLIP] by Skibidi_Fontan121 — OK")
